input: Owner direction 2026-11-26 (relayed): build the Cloudflare -> AWS cutover as one pipeline (everything Cloudflare holds as OpenTofu, AWS via OIDC, priv-cutover.yml with owner approval, short-lived tokens deleted after, external clocks scheduled), on top of platform/aws.

doc_friction.issue: 'Checks' says providers came from releases.hashicorp.com through a filesystem mirror, but the OpenTofu registry's h1 hashes for hashicorp/aws 6.72.0 differ from that mirror's, so -lockfile=readonly fails locally; and hashicorp's mirror has no cloudflare/cloudflare v5 (GitHub release downloads do). Local tests need the lock file moved aside.
aws-guardrail-weakened warns 'StringLike on an OIDC condition' for an s3:prefix condition; the rule matches any StringLike in a file with an OIDC trust.

deviations.why: Cutover secrets in AWS Secrets Manager read through OIDC, not GitHub environment secrets; DNS kept on Cloudflare by default with Route 53 as an optional track; email sender unchanged until SES production access. Relayed owner refinements from the orchestrating session, each narrowing risk.
deviations.did: Built the default path that way and documented the full-exit calendar
deviations.result: one approved run on the day, no registrar or nameserver step

deviations.why: A second applier of AWS stacks would duplicate the reviewed apply pipeline and widen the cutover role to administrator
deviations.did: prepare checks that each app's AWS stack is applied and healthy instead

deviations.file: system brief, point 3 (site crawl with check.mjs)
deviations.why: platform/pages/check.mjs checks a built artifact, not a live site, and the deploy pipeline already runs it
deviations.did: verify crawls the live sitemap (100 URLs per host) and requires 200 from AWS

notes: Verification run here: python3 -m pytest platform/aws -q 74 passed (39 new); tofu test stacks/cloudflare 8 passed, stacks/cutover-access 4 passed (OpenTofu 1.13.10, mocked providers); saas-starter runtime npm test 17 passed; data-copy.test.mjs against a real Postgres 16, 5 passed; checkov 3.4.10 stacks/cutover-access 93 passed 0 failed; ci_policy_check passes; adversarial gate rules locally: only the Paddle hosts block, cleared by PR #19203 (merge first). Nothing run against real Cloudflare, AWS or Paddle.
